title: CreditAccess Grameen Q2 profit jumps fourfold to Rs 502 crore

title: Tesla shares slip after capex cut raises doubts over Musk's AI and robotics push
description: Tesla's shares dipped by 2% after it reduced its capital spending forecast for 2026, now predicting $20 billion instead of the previous $25 billion. This move has raised eyebrows among investors, especially with Tesla's stock already down 14% this year. Yet, it still boasts a higher valuation than many traditional automakers. Meanwhile, potential merger talks with SpaceX hint at regulatory hurdles that might prolong uncertainty for investors.

title: Kolkata home registrations dip 12 per cent in Jan-Sep; larger flats gain share
description: In the first three quarters of 2026, home registrations in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area fell to 41,309, highlighting a year-on-year decline. Yet, there was an observable trend towards mid-sized and larger apartments. Specifically, September recorded 4,845 registrations, down from the previous year, with North Kolkata dominating 36% of the total shares. This data reveals a growing preference for spacious and practical living spaces among buyers.

title: Hatsun Agro Product Q2 Results: Profit rises 5.6% on strong sales
description: Hatsun Agro Product reported a notable growth in net profit for the September quarter, reaching Rs 115.69 crore, up from Rs 109.54 crore from last year. Total income also surged to Rs 2,902.49 crore, showcasing strong sales amidst industry hurdles. The company emphasizes enhancing direct consumer relationships and expanding its market footprint in Maharashtra and Odisha, while continuing to invest in its procurement, processing, and distribution systems.

title: US stocks today: US stocks open lower as AI jitters return, oil rises
description: US stocks opened lower on Thursday as renewed concerns over the outlook for artificial intelligence weighed on growth stocks. Tesla and Meta earnings failed to ease AI-related jitters, while rising oil prices added to market pressure. The Nasdaq fell 1.48%, while the S&P 500 and Dow also declined at the open.

title: Record galore! Jio IPO claims crown for highest QIB demand among India’s 5 largest issues, edges past NSE
description: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213-crore IPO attracted 12.87 times QIB subscription, surpassing NSE’s institutional demand. Overall subscription reached 5.36 times by Day 2, with a strong grey market premium and positive brokerage recommendations.

title: US stocks 2026: Moderna, SanDisk lead top 10 gainers delivering up to 734% returns

Healthcare and tech sectors dominate, led by biotechnology firm Moderna and flash memory maker SanDisk, highlighting strong momentum across biotech and established tech majors like Dell.

title: SoFi targets idle crypto cash with interest-bearing tokenized deposit
description: SoFi Technologies has launched an innovative tokenized deposit product that offers an attractive 4.2% annual interest rate. Funds deposited are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for amounts up to $250,000 per depositor. This strategic move enables customers to prepare for crypto acquisitions while still earning interest, rather than letting cash sit idle.

title: Colgate-Palmolive India Q2 Results: Profit rises 4.3% to Rs 341.6 crore
description: Colgate-Palmolive India Ltd has reported a 4.3% increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company achieved a net profit of Rs 341.57 crore compared to Rs 327.51 crore last year. Sales increased by 12.22% to Rs 1,691.57 crore in this quarter. The gross margin expanded by 40 basis points year-on-year, reflecting cost management strategies and pricing actions.
